copy: Cramzz is my recurring series: building small internet experiments in public, giving each 14 days to earn its next step, then sharing the receipts. First: Packet Panic. Route a packet around congestion and broken links in six hops. No account. https://cramzz.space/e/packet-panic/
alt_text: Packet Panic network puzzle showing a source, destination, congested links, and a six-hop limit.
